mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) and inflation is low (CPIAUCSL < 200), the combination signals sustained monetary accommodation and stable real rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL < 200, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a month-over-month decline in unemployment (UNRATE drops > 0.2pp) signals improving labor market conditions and rising consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE drops > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 2300 thousand units (HOUST > 2300) indicate strong residential construction activity, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenues, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST > 2300, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a declining industrial production regime (INDPRO < 105.0), a rebound in industrial output (INDPRO increases > 0.5% in one month) signals economic stabilization, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 105.0 and INDPRO increases > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are rising (HOUST > 2300 and RSAFS > 360000), the combined strength in consumer spending and housing activity drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when both HOUST > 2300 and RSAFS > 360000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 200) signals that the central bank can maintain low interest rates, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL < 200, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
